context_diary: The account_lookup function supports filtering by account type (AGENT, USER, ADMIN) with configurable return fields and limits. Random sampling is available for agent queries. Aggregation reporting provides count metrics across account types. The system contains 1,498 agents and 8,497 total users. Admin accounts appear to follow a standard "admin@localhost" naming convention. When querying agents, the system warns about large result sets and requires explicit limit parameters to prevent overload.
